items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All U1 Done-when items covered by tests; F0 path added after spec-reviewer round 1.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: open_files_warning never raises; unreadable folder gives no warning, not a wrong count.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Read-only directory listing; symlinked folder treated as absent; no shell interpolation.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Exit-code pin, legacy silence, boundary 149/150, CRLF-translation monkeypatch for both seeder layouts, DROP_NAME parity.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One directory listing, no gh call in the F0 path.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Named constant, small leaf module, no dead code.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Seeder writes the drop file the shared reader consumes; parity test loads the seeder and matches DROP_NAME; append LF probe is a real on-disk byte check.
